Because `sys.path` had `_repo_root` inserted after `_minilinks_dir` at index 0, `from app.server import create_server` resolved to MiniBoard rather than MiniLinks. We resolved this by prioritizing `examples.minilinks.app.server`, placing `_minilinks_dir` strictly at `sys.path[0]`, purging foreign `app` instances from `sys.modules`, defensively handling tuple unwrapping, adding the missing `tests/__init__.py`, and adding BrokenPipeError handling in server.py.
